IDENT.title: Agentic AI for decentralized, natural-language communication and interaction between agents in self-organizing manufacturing systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Following Pulikottil et al. [17], an agent has autonomy, reactivity, pro-activity, social ability; AI agents are LLMs enhanced with tool use.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: Following PULIKOTTIL et al. [17] an agent of a MAS inherits four main characteristics: autonomy, reactivity, pro-activity, and social ability.

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: Following PULIKOTTIL et al. [17] an agent of a MAS inherits four main characteristics

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: agents representing manufacturing things are enhanced with LLMs to increase autonomy and social ability, hence becoming AI agents.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: each representing one manufacturing thing, such as a machine, a workpiece, a product, or a transportation system

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: It defines the role of the agent (see general tasks above), describes the assigned manufacturing thing, and lists the available tool calls.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: The system prompt of the LLM describing the agent’s tasks and capabilities

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: When an agent receives a question from a user or another agent, the LLM is invoked.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: the implemented system was too limited in scale to exhibit such phenomena

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: tool calls tailored to the respective manufacturing thing, and a communication interface to other agents

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: These tool calls were mapped to Python methods within the LangChain environment

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: equipped with a system prompt describing the agent’s tasks, the properties of the lifting tower, and available tool calls

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: System prompt describing tasks, asset properties and tools; no history retained.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: equipped with a system prompt describing the agent’s tasks, the properties of the lifting tower, and available tool calls

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: status tool calls which provide real-time information about status variables of the manufacturing thing

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: Each agent perceives only part of the environment and acts based on its perception.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: status tool calls which provide real-time information about status variables

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: All communication is conducted in natural language.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If an agent cannot perform a task, task allocation between the agents is resolved through communication.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: Every agent can address questions to any other agent.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: non-negligible response times (ranging between 1.0 and 11.8 s)

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.evidence_quote: non-negligible response times (ranging between 1.0 and 11.8 s)

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: The initial question is appended with the tool message, and the LLM is invoked again recursively.

E_LEARNING__uses_foundation_model.evidence_quote: For all validation tests, the Gemini 2.5 Flash model was used.

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_role.evidence_quote: large language model-based agents can facilitate dynamic task allocation through communication in natural language

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.value: Partial processing due to premature final message (26.7%), empty/out-of-context messages (11.7%), latency 1.0–11.8 s, hallucination risk, limited causal reasoning/global optimization.
E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.evidence_quote: mostly due to a premature generation of the final text message instead of further tool calls

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: To validate the simulation, the lifting tower agent was implemented on a real demonstrator.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: a demonstrator consisting of a robot and a lifting tower placed next to each other

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: a demonstrator consisting of a robot and a lifting tower

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: the agentic communication is supposed to be interoperable between all agents

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The framework proposes a bidirectional communication without hierarchy to maintain a decentralized MAS.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Uses unstructured natural-language LLM communication and LLM tool calls instead of formal model-based representation, capability discovery or plan generation; no formal models.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: Communication is designed to occur in an unstructured manner through natural language.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Agents must be heterarchical and exhibit four characteristics; each agent must be able to communicate with others.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: To enable cooperation among individual agents, each agent must be able to communicate with other agents.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: LIM et al. [28] present an LLM-enabled MAS for adapting G-code

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The system can be expanded with additional agents.
